correctness.rationale: All q>=5: independent witness sections share exactly 2q-3 torus zeros. For any independent pair, coprime Newton polygons have intersection at most six. With common factor h, exhaustive 127-subset Newton shape classification yields only primitive segment, unimodular triangle, and unit parallelogram possibilities with at least two residual monomials; their respective contributions are at most (q-1)+2, (q-2)+1, and 2q-3. In parallelogram case the residual two-monomial space has no simultaneous zeros. Every step is constructive; exact standalone enumeration of finite support-shape lemma and q=5 exhaustive rank check pass.

value.rationale: The second higher Hamming weight is the natural maximum-base-locus invariant of anticanonical pencils on a smooth degree-six toric del Pezzo surface. Exact q-uniform determination, including the first boundary prime power q=5 and characteristic-two extensions, is not routine code parameter substitution; its sharpness depends on a complete sparse Newton-factor classification and mixed-volume intersection analysis.
